summary.zh: 抓取视频字幕、搜索结果并追踪频道更新
summary.en: Pull transcripts and search results, track channels

description.zh: 针对任意 YouTube 链接、视频 ID 或 @handle，提取字幕、搜索结果、频道与播放列表信息，也能持续关注新上传内容。适合资料整理、竞品频道调研或选题参考。需要联网，并安装 yt-dlp 与 youtube-transcript-api，无需 API Key。
description.en: Fetches transcripts, search results, channel and playlist data for any YouTube URL, video ID or @handle, and tracks new uploads. Suits research and competitor audits. Needs network access plus yt-dlp; no API key.
